question: Does Window.has_focus() agree with focus_entered/focus_exited on Web, including the hidden-IME focus case?

sources.title: Godot Web DisplayServer focus implementation
sources.claim: Web window_is_focused() currently returns true unconditionally while focus events are forwarded from DOM canvas events

sources.title: Godot Window focus event/query implementation
sources.claim: FOCUS_OUT stores focused=false and emits focus_exited, while Window.has_focus() delegates to DisplayServer for native windows

commands: Export the same project to Web and exercise canvas focus, browser focus loss, return, and LineEdit/IME focus
distinguishing_outcomes: Desktop focus_exited prints has_focus=false while Web focus_exited prints has_focus=true: retain the Web query mismatch.
Web focus_exited prints has_focus=false: source assumptions are incomplete; inspect browser/export glue before any candidate patch.
Focusing the Godot LineEdit causes a window focus exit: candidate semantics must account for hidden IME focus before implementation.
Focusing the Godot LineEdit preserves Godot window focus: canvas-or-IME is the leading query semantics.
stop_condition: Capture one desktop control and one Web focus-out/return trace plus one Web LineEdit/IME trace.
